name: LiveCoach
description: Coach a body movement, exercise or stretch: arrows and labels on the user's body showing how to move.
examples: How do I stretch my shoulders?
How should I hold the racket?
note: Foundational MOD defined as a spec (modos-system-design.md 5.3): the system can choose it and its text answers; its selectors and representations are not implemented yet.

default.label: Arrows and labels on the body
